prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop AI redesign concept bitmap for TALKPIK AI user app
Primary request: Create concept-03 for page 27-X-05-profile-editing, state default. Reference state: profile settings with unchanged fields and disabled save. Create a form-state-focused variant: it should be obvious what can be edited and why saving is currently disabled.
Composition/framing: desktop 1280x900 edge-to-edge app UI screenshot only; no browser address bar, tabs, bookmarks bar, OS title bar, device frame, or watermark. Preserve left sidebar with profile active. Main: clean form stack with email, name, nickname, bio counter, profile image upload; each field has concise helper text. Add a muted security notice panel. Save button disabled with unchanged-state hint. Right rail: target exam and account status cards with edit/settings links.
Style/medium: polished Ant Design-friendly profile form, compact density, accessible labels and helper text, neutral workspace, no decorative profile illustration.
Color palette: Mist/Snow/Fog/Obsidian; Obsidian for active navigation/selected controls only, disabled save gray, muted info banner blue-gray.
Typography: Cosmica-like modern sans, Korean UI text as visual direction only, no negative letter spacing, form text fits cleanly.
Must preserve state signals: profile form fields, avatar image change, bio character count, security notice, disabled save button, target exam card, account status card.
Avoid: browser chrome, OS frame, device frame, loud gradient, colorful CTA, exposing real email, heavy shadows, over-rounded controls.
